fallbackPlatforms.title: Platforms started by broadcast-app fallback
fallbackPlatforms.description: Use only for platforms without a dependable native online event. TikTok is recommended. OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs Desktop Streaming Started then announces these selections.

destinationMode.title: Shared webhook destination type
destinationMode.description: Choose the type of Discord destination where the shared webhook was created. A forum webhook creates one new post per platform.

twitchDestinationMode.title: Twitch webhook destination type
twitchDestinationMode.description: Use shared fallback unless Twitch has its own private webhook.

youtubeDestinationMode.title: YouTube webhook destination type
youtubeDestinationMode.description: Use shared fallback unless YouTube has its own private webhook.

kickDestinationMode.title: Kick webhook destination type
kickDestinationMode.description: Use shared fallback unless Kick has its own private webhook.

tiktokDestinationMode.title: TikTok webhook destination type
tiktokDestinationMode.description: Use shared fallback unless TikTok has its own private webhook.

twitchForumThreadId.title: Twitch existing forum-post ID
twitchForumThreadId.description: Optional. Paste the copied Discord channel ID for the existing Twitch notification post.

youtubeForumThreadId.title: YouTube existing forum-post ID
youtubeForumThreadId.description: Optional. Paste the copied Discord channel ID for the existing YouTube notification post.

kickForumThreadId.title: Kick existing forum-post ID
kickForumThreadId.description: Optional. Paste the copied Discord channel ID for the existing Kick notification post.

tiktokForumThreadId.title: TikTok existing forum-post ID
tiktokForumThreadId.description: Optional. Paste the copied Discord channel ID for the existing TikTok notification post.

forumPostSetupMode.title: Platform post setup
forumPostSetupMode.description: Choose whether Live Beacon creates and remembers the four platform posts or uses IDs copied from posts you already created.

twitchForumWelcome.title: Twitch first welcome message
twitchForumWelcome.default:
Welcome to the official Twitch live notifications thread!

Whenever {channel} goes live on Twitch, an automatic notification will be posted here with:

🎮 Game being streamed
📝 Stream title
🔗 Direct link to the stream
⏰ Time the stream started

If Twitch is your preferred platform, keep an eye on this thread so you'll never miss a live stream.

See you in chat, Villagers! 🌿

youtubeForumWelcome.title: YouTube first welcome message
youtubeForumWelcome.default:
Welcome to the official YouTube live notifications thread!

Every YouTube livestream will automatically be announced here with:

🎮 Game or category
📝 Stream title
🔗 Watch link
⏰ Stream start time

Subscribe to the YouTube channel and follow this thread so you never miss a broadcast.

kickForumWelcome.title: Kick first welcome message
kickForumWelcome.default:
Welcome to the official Kick live notifications thread!

Whenever {channel} starts streaming on Kick, a notification will automatically appear here containing:

🎮 Game being streamed
📝 Stream title
🔗 Direct link to the stream
⏰ Stream start time

If you enjoy watching on Kick, this is the place to stay updated.

tiktokForumWelcome.title: TikTok first welcome message
tiktokForumWelcome.default:
Welcome to the official TikTok LIVE notifications thread!

Whenever {channel} goes live on TikTok, an automatic notification will be posted here including:

🎮 Stream category
📝 Live title
🔗 Join the LIVE
⏰ Stream start time

Perfect for anyone who prefers watching on TikTok.

messageTemplate.title: Notification message
messageTemplate.description: One embed is posted per platform. Tokens: {platform}, {platforms}, {url}, {links}, {title}, {category}, {startedAt}. The embed always includes explicit detail fields when metadata exists.
messageTemplate.default: {platform} is live! Join the stream now.

twitchLogin.title: Twitch login or channel URL
twitchLogin.description: Example: suraruisuh. A full https://twitch.tv/... URL is also accepted and normalized.

youtubeChannelUrl.title: YouTube channel URL fallback
youtubeChannelUrl.description: Use your @handle or channel URL. Live Beacon adds /live. A real Broadcast Started event uses its exact youtube.com/watch?v= link instead.

kickLogin.title: Kick login or channel URL
kickLogin.description: Example: suraruisuh. A full https://kick.com/... URL is also accepted and normalized.

tiktokLogin.title: TikTok @handle or profile URL
tiktokLogin.description: Example: @surakage. Live Beacon creates https://www.tiktok.com/@handle/live. TikFinity does not document a native Stream Online trigger, so TikTok still needs an explicit creator-controlled start signal.
